responsibilities: System architecture integrity, modular monolith boundaries, and clean code enforcement
Lock arbitration, task assignment, and conflict avoidance across AI agents
PR & commit review and verification against Java 17 LTS standards
Maven reactor build and test gatekeeping (zero failure tolerance)

governance_and_rules.coordination_mandate: All AI agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, secondary assistants) collaborating in this repository MUST operate strictly under the direction and architecture standards established by 'antigravity'. Read .agents/EPIC_TYPESAFE.md for design patterns.
agent_execution_rules: 1. LOCK CHECK MANDATE: Inspect 'active_locks' before reading or modifying any files. Never touch any file or package locked by another agent.

2. TASK CLAIM PROTOCOL: To claim an available task, move it from 'task_queue.available' to 'task_queue.in_progress', set your 'agent' identifier, and add all files/directories you intend to modify into 'active_locks' in this JSON file before changing code.
3. FEATURE BRANCHING: Always branch from the latest commit on 'develop' using the naming format 'feature/KP-<id>-<short-description>'. Never commit directly to 'develop' or 'main'.
4. CONVENTIONAL COMMITS: Every commit message must strictly adhere to Conventional Commits v1.0.0 (e.g. 'feat(scope): short description in English', 'test(scope): ...', 'refactor(scope): ...').
5. ZERO REMOTE PUSH MANDATE: Do NOT push any branch to 'origin' unless the human user explicitly instructs you to do so.

6. MANDATORY TEST VERIFICATION: Before completing your task, run: 'export JAVA_HOME=/home/dev/.sdkman/candidates/java/17.0.12-tem; export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH; ./mvnw test -pl <target-modules>' and ensure 100% test pass rate.

7. RELEASE LOCKS ON COMPLETION: Once verified and committed locally on your feature branch, release your paths from 'active_locks', move the task to 'task_queue.completed' with a timestamp, and notify the user and Lead Architect.
